name: Bonescythe Bracers
label: Quest
description: Bonescythe Bracers: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you want Bonescythe made, you're going to have to supply the materials.

Enter Naxxramas, the big floating city of death in the sky up there, and find desecrated armor and wartorn armor scraps. Bring those back along with the materials to put everything together and you'll have your Bonescythe. Oh, and you'll need to pay me for my troubles... I'll supply the bones.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How do you expect me to get anything done without the items I requested?
